name: Ironblood Pact Colorblock Territory Jacket
description: A heavyweight salvage-canvas jacket cut wide at the shoulders, paneled in the Ironblood Collective's signature burnt-orange and raw-iron grey. Back panel carries a hand-pressed gang sigil in cracked rubber ink — a stylized gear split by a lightning bolt — surrounded by district patch clusters stitched in layered embroidery. Sleeve seams are deliberately split and re-laced with steel-braid cord, marking a member who has survived at least one territorial confrontation. Interior lining is mismatched salvage fabric, each piece sourced from a different dead corponation uniform.
functionality: Reinforced back panel absorbs minor impact. Laced sleeve seams can be quickly torn open to accommodate chrome arm augmentations during conflict. Interior pockets are heat-sealed for acid rain resistance.
what_it_says: This wearer belongs somewhere, and crossing them means crossing everyone who wears this color.
worn_by: ex-members who kept the jacket anyway
price_range: Φ0 (earned, not purchased) — black market Φ180–Φ400
story_hooks: A runner finds a dead Ironblood member's jacket — wearing it could open doors or get them killed depending on which district they're in.
A corponation intelligence analyst has been tasked with mapping gang patch genealogy to predict territorial shifts — she needs a jacket to go undercover.
Someone is selling authenticated Ironblood jackets to Tier 4 fashion tourists, and the Collective has noticed.
